data.title: 猫咖窗台借猫说出的喜欢

data.animaCaption: Scratching the chin of a sleepy ginger tabby curled across her lap on the sunlit window bench, she glances up with a soft blush as if letting the cat speak for her. Bright afternoon window light turns the cat's fur golden and warms her calm expression.
data.promptProse: Captured at eye level beside the sunny window bench of a quiet cat café, Shiki Natsume sits relaxed in her dark olive utility jacket, black ribbed top, and jeans with a plump ginger tabby cat purring contentedly across her lap. As her slender fingers gently scratch beneath the cat's chin, she glances up toward the viewer with softened golden eyes and a telltale rosy tint on her cheeks, bathed in rich afternoon sunlight streaming through the wide café window.
data.story: 午后的阳光把窗台烘得暖洋洋的，那只橘猫熟门熟路盘在夏目膝盖上打呼噜。夏目一边慢悠悠给它挠下巴，一边眼皮微抬看向对面的你，耳尖泛红却一脸严肃——「它刚才说，下周还想让你陪我再来一次。可不是我说的。」
